title: GlossaryTerm
description: Input contract for the glossary->taxonomy builder. This is what the builder needs from your existing glossary; the richer the optional fields, the better the induced taxonomy.

definition.description: The semantic payload; the embedding source for clustering.

synonyms.description: Acronyms / jargon variants -> become skos:altLabel (critical for matching enterprise text).

see_also.description: Related term ids/labels -> become skos:related edges.

provisions.description: ITA/Reg/IT/Folio anchors, e.g. '54', '20(1)(a)', 'IT-518R' -> authority grouping prior.

domain.description: Pre-existing coarse category from the source glossary (reconciled, not overridden), e.g. 'Capital gains', 'GST/HST'.

legal_flag.description: Source flag, e.g. 'Plain-language' vs 'Legal/technical' — carries the not-law caveat.
